svg.aria-label: Top: validation loss and accuracy on 500 fresh sequences at each length. The vertical line marks training length 16. Bottom: readout probability of the true opening class along one 64-step record. Hidden width is 16; RNN/LSTM/GRU have 337/1,297/977 parameters. Data follow the stated synthetic task.
